direction.app_shape: Node 24 storefront and private engine in one supervised container
direction.database: Existing Supabase remains unchanged during the hosting migration
direction.edge_dns: Cloudflare DNS/CDN may be retained, but DNS is not changed by this contract

why_not_static_only: public/server.js is a Node HTTP server and proxies engine routes
BEC-PRIME/start.js runs a Node HTTP server and multiple commerce, webhook and marketplace route handlers
the engine uses filesystem-backed jobs, proofs and ledger paths
a static-only upload or the existing Cloudflare preview returns 503 for dynamic commerce routes
